answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is scarce original authorship: each identity must produce a distinctive quill of high-grade answers that harden into a marble record of verified work before gaining attestation power. Recycled text is treated as empty nectar that fails peer review and triggers slash. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or transferred without detection.
